subject: Inner physical prewake has no explicit Duo revocation path
body: HEAD=413d4a722fe8193f15ff086595f10d1464505ace. SOURCE-CONFIRMED: Fold7ContinuityController exposes WakeInner, coordinator dispatches wakeInner(), and DuoShellService has the one hidden SurfaceControl.setDisplayPowerMode(..., POWER_MODE_NORMAL=2) path for the inner panel. No SleepInner/inner POWER_MODE_OFF/revocation action exists in the controller/coordinator/shell path. Therefore an opening-edge prewake followed by an early reversal relies on Samsung/native display policy to return the inner physical panel to the appropriate power state. Do not add an explicit OFF yet: that could fight Samsung ownership. Required device test: measure inner physical/logical power after reversals at <8deg, 8-20deg, and later opening; compare with no-prewake baseline and verify no residual powered panel, flash, thermal/power tail, or delayed cover recovery.
